messages:
nisha_pm: Quick sync - customer wants a narrow private pilot for Q3 with deterministic launch gates and a fast rollback path. Need to map owners + acceptance checks.
tyler_prodeng: want the asks upfront so we can scope infra changes. Do they require reserved capacity or just soft prewarm?
nisha_pm: reserved capacity during business hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00 PT) for 7 days, 8 slots, and a progressive ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. Add canary validation run-books.
ravi_runtime: 8 slots across 2 zones is doable but changes kernel scheduling. We'll need a prewarm window of 45m and an autoscaler min floor during pilot hours. Cost uptick estimated around +12% token/op cost.
marta_infra: I'll need the exact time windows to file capacity reservations and update autoscaler policies. Also recommend a cross-zone affinity tag: `pilot-reserve:tenant-xyz` so we can track billing and evictions.
kai_security: For pilot we require: tenant-scoped KMS keys for cache encryption, VPC egress rules locked to customer's IP ranges during pilot, and a quick threat-review checklist signed by security lead before canary.
lina_devrel: UX asks: feature-flag in Console `tenant.pilot_mode`, visible pilot stage indicator, and a small modal showing rollback button + link to playbook. I'll prototype. Metric names needed for the card.
tyler_prodeng: Responsibilities: runtime = prewarm script + slow-start logic; infra = reservation and zone spread; security = KMS + review; devrel = UI; product = launch checklist + customer comms.
ravi_runtime: tech details: slow-start: only double traffic when `rtd.gpu_util < 75%` and `rtd.p99.latency < 350ms` for 10m. Rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 210ms for 15m OR error spikes (5xx rate > 0.8% for 5m) OR model-quality alerts from eval harness. Add an emergency-mode: switch traffic to a lighter model family `m-lite-v2` with `redwoodctl route set --model m-lite-v2`.
marta_infra: reservation spec I'll add to infra PR: `reserved_slots:8`, `hours: Mon-Fri 16:00-01:00 UTC` (matches customer peak), `zone_spread: true`, `billing_tag: pilot-tenant-xyz`. I'll include monthly $ estimate.
kai_security: Also: audit log retention 60 days for pilot, and mute any PII sampling jobs. Need an on-call contact for incident escalation.
lina_devrel: metric names: `pilot.lat.p95`, `pilot.errors.5xx_rate`, `pilot.gpu.util`, `pilot.token.delta`. I'll wire those to the pilot card.
tyler_prodeng: define acceptance gate checklist: 1) staging prewarm run (end-to-end) with >95% of slots healthy 2) canary 2% for 12h with no triggers 3) ramp to 10% for 6h 4) full ramp with monitoring. Must have signed security checklist after step 1.
ci-bot: CI: staging-prewarm job scheduled for 2024-08-12T14:00:00Z. Logs will land at ci.redwood/pilot/staging/prewarm.
ravi_runtime: testing plan: run `./tools/prewarm --tenant xyz --slots 8 --duration 45m --model m-prod` in staging; capture rtd traces and a small synthetic query set to validate quality.
marta_infra: I'll open infra PR ASAP and tag @tyler_prodeng and @kai_security. Expect PR link by EOD tomorrow.
nisha_pm: great. Action items consolidated: - infra PR with reservation + cost estimate - runtime prewarm + slow-start implementation - security review + KMS config - devrel pilot card + UI toggle - product publish checklist and customer comms. Who wants to volunteer as launch lead on D-day?
tyler_prodeng: I'll take launch lead for coordination.
kai_security: I'll be on-call for the pilot window and do the threat check.
ravi_runtime: I'll run the staging prewarm and post perf numbers.
lina_devrel: I'll ship the pilot card mock and flag in Console.
ci-bot: Reminder: please add `pilot:tenant-xyz` label to all PRs related to this pilot.
nisha_pm: thanks team. I'll draft the launch checklist and circulate. If anyone sees missing gates, reply here before EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:
